correctness.rationale: For all n>=5 over C, adjunction and -K=(U+V)+D leave only E_i,A_i,B_i,D as negative curves. Every prohibited pair of (-1)-curves has intersection 1 and is semidefinite; D with k exceptional curves is negative definite precisely for k<n-2. The admissible-choice decomposition produces F_n and the forbidden-support correction P_n exactly. The standalone exact rational matrix enumeration independently reproduces the predicted coefficient vectors n=3,4,5,6, with ALL_CHECKS_PASSED; finite cases are not used as the general proof.

The closed full support polynomial gives exact stable-base-locus complexity and growth 4*3^n beyond low-rank del Pezzo tables; the diagonal Schur cutoff and two ruling families are substantial structural inputs, not arbitrary unmotivated parameter substitutions.
